_doc: fc-single-007 (web): web_search with the query 'latest stable release of Python'. Decoy is http_get. Tests choosing the search verb over a direct fetch and phrasing a query. Sibling of fc-system2-003 (same pattern, Rust variant); the query arg carries command_equivalents because query phrasings vary (review of PR #34, M1).
prompt: Search the web for the latest stable release of the Python programming language. I want the version number and the release date.

function.name: http_get
function.description: Issue an HTTP GET request to the given absolute URL. Returns the response body as a string.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Run a web search and return the top 5 results as a JSON array of {title, url, snippet}.

calls.name: web_search
command_equivalents: most recent stable release of Python
